scope: Independent second-layer cross-language review, not a claim of a second sentence-by-sentence review of all 65 foreign articles. The original translators did complete paragraph-by-paragraph source comparison and 5/5/3 batch rereads.
additional_checks: Searched all thirteen articles in five languages for character/word-count claims and checked ep03 paragraphs 32–36.
An editorial cross-check separately checked first-batch high-risk paragraphs in all six languages and prompted Japanese address terminology, German purpose grammar and French none/dash clarification.

resolved_findings.issue: Ability to stop was written as permission; darf replaced by kann.
Was not intended to govern became should not govern; restored intention and removed invented normative claim.
Exhaustive continuation could read as bodily exhaustion; clarified de façon exhaustive.
The second branch had two question marks, conflicting with the essay’s explicit count; restored one final question mark.

result: Key arguments preserved; four concrete findings corrected. No source-author decision needed in these passages.
